title: 一把伞 Yì bǎ sǎn — The umbrella left behind
summary: On a rainy afternoon Ah Ming finds an umbrella in the coffee shop he forgot it in, and the name on it is his own.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: Read the story once without stopping at words. The lines mix a narrator with the two people, and every line has pinyin and English under it.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: Wàimiàn xià yǔ le.
body.en: It is raining outside.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: Ā Míng zài túshūguǎn kàn shū.
body.en: Ah Ming is reading in the library.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: tā méiyǒu dài sǎn.
body.en: He did not bring an umbrella.

body.speaker: 阿明
body.py: wǒ xiān qù hē bēi kāfēi.
body.en: I will get a coffee first.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: Yǔ hěn dà, tā pǎo de hěn kuài.
body.en: The rain is heavy and he runs fast.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 他在店里坐了一个小时。
body.py: tā zài diàn lǐ zuò le yí gè xiǎoshí.
body.en: He sits in the shop for an hour.

body.speaker: 阿明
body.py: Tiān qíng le, wǒ gāi zǒu le.
body.en: The sky has cleared, I should go.

body.speaker: 店员
body.py: Nǐ de sǎn zài zhèlǐ!
body.en: Your umbrella is here!

body.speaker: 阿明
body.py: zhè bú shì wǒ de.
body.en: This is not mine.

body.speaker: 店员
body.py: shàngmian yǒu yí gè míngzi.
body.en: There is a name on it.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: Ā Míng kàn le kan nàge míngzi.
body.en: Ah Ming takes a look at the name.

body.speaker: 阿明
body.py: zhè shì wǒ de míngzi!
body.en: That is my name!

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: Ā Míng xiǎng qǐlai le.
body.en: Ah Ming remembers now.

body.speaker: 阿明
body.py: shàngwǔ wǒ zài zhèr děng péngyou.
body.en: This morning I waited here for a friend.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: tā zài zhèlǐ diū guo wàitào.
body.en: He lost his coat here once.

body.speaker: 店员
body.py: wàitào zài yǐzi shàng.
body.en: The coat is on the chair.

body.speaker: 阿明
body.py: Sǎn shì wǒ de. xièxie nǐ!
body.en: The umbrella is mine. Thank you!

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: sǎn shì lánsè de, yǒu ge dòng.
body.en: The umbrella is blue and has a hole.

body.speaker: 店员
body.py: bú yòng xiè. xià cì bié wàng la.
body.en: No need to thank me. Do not forget next time.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 回家的路上，天又下雨了。
body.py: huíjiā de lùshang, tiān yòu xià yǔ le.
body.en: On the way home it rains again.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: zhè cì Ā Míng yǒu sǎn.
body.en: This time Ah Ming has an umbrella.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: tā hé tóngxué yìqǐ dǎ sǎn.
body.en: He shares the umbrella with his classmates.

body.speaker: 同学
body.py: nǐ zhēn gòu péngyou.
body.en: You are a real friend.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: tāmen yìqǐ chī le júzi.
body.en: They eat some oranges together.

blocks.title: Words in this story
body: 下雨 xià yǔ — to rain
想起来 xiǎng qǐlai — to remember
路上 lùshang — on the way
够朋友 gòu péngyou — a true friend

blocks.body: Think about it: Why was the umbrella in the shop? What did Ah Ming do on the way home? Answer in one Chinese sentence each, for example starting with 因为 yīnwèi (because).

A made-up reading passage written from scratch for this project. Any resemblance to a published graded reader, coursebook story, or official exam text is accidental; nothing here is taken from a commercial course.
